security-firewall.description: Antigravity 2.18.1 Mechanical Security Firewall: Protects raw data immutability, blocks catastrophic system commands, and enforces ASCII English filenames across all agents and subagents.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,sys; f='.agents/scripts/security_firewall.py' if os.path.exists('.agents/scripts/security_firewall.py') else 'scripts/security_firewall.py'; os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, f] + sys.argv[1:])"

deliverable-validation-gate.description: Antigravity 2.18.1 Mechanical Stop Verification Gate: Enforces clean release gates for formal benchmarks while allowing subagents and interactive sessions to complete seamlessly.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,sys; f='.agents/scripts/mechanical_stop_gate.py' if os.path.exists('.agents/scripts/mechanical_stop_gate.py') else 'scripts/mechanical_stop_gate.py'; os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, f] + sys.argv[1:])"
